<a id="three-dimensional"></a>
# 3+1D

**Phase convention:** physical, as fixed in the [formula guide](../FORMULA_GUIDE.md#phase-convention): the forward F move carries $`\nu`$, the consistency loop runs forward along $`D`$ and back along $`N`$, the insertions are $`X=P\Gamma`$ and $`\bar X=\bar P\Gamma^\dagger`$, and coefficients are signed minimal representatives.

Use the [common notation](../FORMULA_GUIDE.md#conventions-and-coordinates). Every physical field and layer below belongs to this dimension.

Throughout this section the physical fields are:

| Field | Physical role | Coefficients |
|---|---|---|
| $`n_1`$ | p+ip decoration | $`\mathbb Z_{s_1}`$ |
| $`n_2`$ | Majorana decoration | $`\mathbb Z_2`$ |
| $`n_3`$ | Complex-fermion decoration | $`\mathbb Z_2`$ |
| $`\nu_4`$ | Bosonic phase | $`U(1)_{s_1}`$ |

<a id="obstructions-3d"></a>
<a id="lower-sources"></a>
## Obstruction functions

### 1. p+ip obstruction

<a id="eq-integer-3d"></a>

```math
d_{s_1}n_1=0.
```

### 2. Majorana obstruction

<a id="eq-l1"></a>

```math
dn_2=\mathcal{𝒪}_3=\mathcal{𝒪}_3^\psi.
```

**p+ip contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{𝒪}_3^\psi=\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2.
```

### 3. Complex-fermion obstruction

<a id="eq-l2"></a>

```math
dn_3=\mathcal{𝒪}_4=\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi.
```

**Majorana contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma=n_2^2+s_1(n_2\cup_1n_2)+\omega_2n_2.
```

**Mixed Majorana–p+ip contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}=dn_2\cup_1n_2+s_1(n_2\cup_2dn_2).
```

Here $`dn_2=\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2`$ is fixed by the preceding obstruction.

**p+ip contribution.**

<a id="eq-l3"></a>

```math
\begin{aligned}
{\mathcal{𝒪}^\psi_4}={}&\zeta_{2,1}({\widetilde{\omega}_2},{[n_{1}]_2})+({\widetilde{\omega}_2}\cup_1{\widetilde{\omega}_2}+{s_1}{\widetilde{\omega}_2}){[\lfloor n_{1}/2\rfloor]_2}\\
&+\big[({\widetilde{\omega}_2}\cup_1{\widetilde{\omega}_2})\cup_1{s_1}+{s_1}({s_1}\cup_1{\widetilde{\omega}_2})\big]{[n_{1}]_2},\\
\zeta_{2,1}({\widetilde{\omega}_2},{[n_{1}]_2})(01234)={}&{\widetilde{\omega}_2}(012){\widetilde{\omega}_2}(023){[n_{1}]_2}(23){[n_{1}]_2}(34).
\end{aligned}
```

The second digit obeys $`d[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2=[n_1]_2^2+s_1[n_1]_2`$.

### 4. Bosonic obstruction

<a id="eq-t3"></a>

```math
d_{s_1}\nu_4=\mathcal{𝒪}_5
 =\mathcal{𝒪}_5^c
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{c\gamma}
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{c\psi}
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_5^\gamma
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{\gamma\psi}
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_5^\psi.
```

The decoration $`n_3`$ is the point-fermion occupation in the geometric pairing
reference. The formulas below use the fixed binary three-cochain

```math
B_3=n_2\cup_1n_2,
```

the pairing reference of the complex fermions. All phases are in the physical
convention of the [guide](../FORMULA_GUIDE.md#phase-convention). For $`n_1=0`$
every contribution reduces to the
[closed-sector formulas](MAJORANA_AND_ENDPOINTS.md#majorana-3d).

#### Complex fermions

```math
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^c
 =\frac12[\omega_2n_3+n_3\cup_1n_3+dn_3\cup_2n_3].
```

#### Complex fermions and Majorana decoration

```math
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{c\gamma}
=\frac12\big[\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}\big]\cup_3\big[\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}\big].
```

The bracket includes the reference correction to the preceding parity:
$`\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}=\mathrm{Sq}^2n_2
+\omega_2n_2+s_1\mathrm{Sq}^1n_2+d(n_2\cup_1n_2)`$.
Its mixed component retains the terms proportional to $`dn_2`$;
no closed-input assumption is made. The outer superscript records the
exchanged fermion operators. Reusing their full parity does not change
that physical origin.

#### Complex fermions and p+ip decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{c\psi}
 =\frac12\Big[&(\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi})\cup_3\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\cup_3(\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi})
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\cup_3\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\\
 &+d(n_2\cup_1n_2)\cup_2(n_2\cup_1n_2)
  +d(n_2\cup_1n_2)\cup_3\big(dn_3+d(n_2\cup_1n_2)\big)\\
 &+\sum_{(v;\mathbf x)\in\mathcal I_5^{c\psi}}
       \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\mathbf x)\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

```math
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{(v;\boldsymbol x)\in\mathcal I_5^{c\psi}}
 \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\boldsymbol x)
={}&\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1212313}(dn_3+d(n_2\cup_1n_2),\omega_2,dn_2)\\
&+\big(\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{121341431}+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{241431341}
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{124214131}+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{121431341}\\
&\qquad+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{142141314}+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{142141341}\big)
 (dn_3+d(n_2\cup_1n_2),s_1,n_2,dn_2).
\end{aligned}
```

The finite sum contains **seven specified MS terms**,
[listed explicitly](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_WORD_INDICES.md#complex-fermion-indices).
The displayed cups give eight terms after distributing their sums, so the contribution has **fifteen terms**.
Every MS term contains $`dn_2=\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2`$ and
$`dn_3+dB_3=\mathcal{𝒪}_4+dB_3`$, so the complex-fermion exchange correction
depends on the full lower parity differential. The terms with $`B_3`$ vanish
for $`n_1=0`$. The
[exact reduction](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_CF_EXCHANGE_REDUCTION.md#the-obstruction)
gives the seven-word form.

#### Majorana decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^\gamma
={}&\frac12\Big[
 \zeta_{2,2}(\omega_2,n_2)\\
&\qquad+\mathcal X_5(n_2)
 +(n_2^2)\cup_3(\omega_2n_2)\\
&\qquad+(n_2^2)\cup_3(s_1[\beta^-n_2]_2)
 +(\omega_2n_2)\cup_3(s_1[\beta^-n_2]_2)\\
&\qquad+\zeta_{1,3}(s_1,[\beta^-n_2]_2)
 +(\omega_2\cup_1s_1)[\beta^-n_2]_2
 +s_1n_2^2\Big]\\
&+\frac14\Big[
 \omega_2\beta^-n_2
 +(\beta^-n_2)\cup_1(\beta^-n_2)
 +s_1^2(\beta^-n_2+
             [\beta^-n_2]_2)\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

Here $`\beta^- x=(dx-[dx]_2)/2`$, with the first differential
formed in integers. It agrees with the ordinary Bockstein on a cocycle.
The word operations are

```math
\begin{aligned}
\zeta_{2,2}(x,y)&=\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1231343}(x,x,y,y),\\
\zeta_{1,3}(x,y)&=\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1231434}(x,x,y,y).
\end{aligned}
```

The intrinsic Adem cochain of a binary two-cochain $`x`$ is

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal X_5(x)={}&\bigl(\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1213243}
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1213431}\\
&\qquad+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1232141}
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1234321}\bigr)(x,x,x,x).
\end{aligned}
```

This operation has four word terms. For $`n_1=0`$ one has $`\beta^-=\beta`$, and the
contribution is the closed-Majorana formula.

#### Majorana and p+ip decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{\gamma\psi}
={}&\frac12\sum_{(v;\mathbf x)\in\mathcal I_5^{\gamma\psi}}
       \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\mathbf x)\\
&-\frac14\Big[
 (\beta^-n_2)\cup_1\beta_3^\psi
 +\beta_3^\psi\cup_1(\beta^-n_2)
 -[(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)n_1]\cup_2(\beta^-n_2)\\
&\qquad-(\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2)n_2
        -n_2(\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2)\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

The sum contains **2,276 ordinary MS terms** after substituting its finite
definitions and collecting equal normalized cochains. This counts the
complete half-valued sum; the quarter-valued terms are separate.

The integer carry and the twisted Bockstein are

```math
\beta_3^\psi
 =\frac{[\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2]_2
                  +\widetilde{\omega}_2 n_1}{2},
\qquad
\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2=\frac{d_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2}{2}.
```

Both divisions are exact. The product $`\widetilde{\omega}_2n_1`$ has the
local-coefficient transport of its two signed integer factors.
The integer terms are read with the following twists. In
$`\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2`$ the factor is the untwisted canonical
zero-or-one lift of the binary product. Inside $`\widetilde{\omega}_2n_1`$,
for example in $`(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)n_1`$, and in the
Pontryagin term $`\mathfrak P_{s_1}(\widetilde{\omega}_2)\cup n_1`$, the cochain
$`\widetilde{\omega}_2`$ carries $`\mathbb Z_{s_1}`$ coefficients.
The finite index set $`\mathcal I_5^{\gamma\psi}`$ is defined in the
[coefficient appendix](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_WORD_INDICES.md#final-physical-index-sets).

#### p+ip decoration

<a id="three-dimensional-pip-source"></a>

On the ordered five-simplex $`(012345)`$, the complete contribution is

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^\psi(012345)
={}&\frac12\Bigg[
 \sum_{(v;\mathbf x)\in\mathcal I_5^\psi}
       \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\mathbf x)
 +\sum_{(f,g)\in\mathcal I_5^{\psi,\mathrm{face}}}f\,g
 \Bigg]\\
&-\frac14\left\{\begin{aligned}
&\beta_3^\psi\cup_1\beta_3^\psi
 -[(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)n_1]\cup_2\beta_3^\psi
 -\omega_2\beta_3^\psi\\
&+(-1)^{s_1(34)}(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)(0123)
  [(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)(0124)
   +(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)(0234)]n_1(34)n_1(45)\\
&-[[\mathrm{Sq}^1[\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2]_2][n_1]_2
 +s_1[\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2]_2[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2
 +s_1(s_1\cup_1[\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2]_2)[n_1]_2]_2
 +[[\lfloor \beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2/2\rfloor]_2[n_1]_2^2]_2
\end{aligned}\right\}
 -\frac1{16}[\mathfrak P_{s_1}(\widetilde{\omega}_2)\cup n_1](012345).
\end{aligned}
```

The two sums contain **583 ordinary MS terms** and **10,825 physical-face
monomials**, respectively, after their coefficient polynomials are fully
expanded and collected. The latter count includes the background factors;
a coefficient-table row is not counted as a single term.

Every cochain expression without explicit arguments is evaluated on
$`(012345)`$. The [word indices](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_WORD_INDICES.md#final-physical-index-sets)
fix $`\mathcal I_5^\psi`$, and the
[physical-face coefficient table](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_INTEGER_SOURCE_FACES.md#physical-integer-source-coefficients)
prints every pair in $`\mathcal I_5^{\psi,\mathrm{face}}`$. Its factors involve only the
physical values of $`n_1`$, $`s_1`$, and $`\omega_2`$ on faces of this same
five-simplex. The table is finite and complete; no auxiliary simplex or
lifted-field evaluation is part of this formula.

The Pontryagin-square convention in the last term is

```math
\mathfrak P_{s_1}(\widetilde{\omega}_2)
=\widetilde{\omega}_2^2
 +\widetilde{\omega}_2\cup_1d_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2.
```

## Stacking twisters

### 1. p+ip stacking

<a id="eq-p1"></a>

```math
N_1=n_1+n'_1.
```

### 2. Majorana stacking

<a id="eq-p2"></a>

```math
N_2=n_2+n'_2+\mathcal{ℰ}_2,\qquad \mathcal{ℰ}_2=\mathcal{ℰ}_2^\psi.
```

**p+ip contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_2^\psi=[n_1]_2[n'_1]_2.
```

### 3. Complex-fermion stacking

<a id="eq-p3"></a>

```math
\begin{aligned}
N_3&=n_3+n'_3+\mathcal{ℰ}_3,\\
\mathcal{ℰ}_3&=\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\gamma+\mathcal{ℰ}_3^{\gamma\psi}+\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\psi.
\end{aligned}
```

**Majorana contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\gamma=n_2\cup_1n'_2+s_1(n_2\cup_2n'_2).
```

**Mixed Majorana–p+ip contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_3^{\gamma\psi}
 =n_2\cup_2dn'_2
 +(n_2+n'_2)\cup_1\mathcal{ℰ}_2
 +s_1\big[(n_2+n'_2)\cup_2\mathcal{ℰ}_2\big].
```

**p+ip contribution.**

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\psi=
 [[n_1]_2\cup_1([n_1]_2[n'_1]_2)][n'_1]_2
 +[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2([n'_1]_2)^2+s_1[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2[n'_1]_2.
```

The pure sheet contribution has three terms. The signed floor is taken before reduction. The complete parity is counted directly by the geometric pairing construction, including both backgrounds.

### 4. Bosonic stacking

<a id="eq-t3b"></a>

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal V_4
 &=\nu_4+\nu'_4+\mathcal{ℰ}_4,\\
\mathcal{ℰ}_4
 &=\mathcal{ℰ}^{c}_4
  +\mathcal{ℰ}^{c\gamma}_4
  +\mathcal{ℰ}^{c\psi}_4
  +\mathcal{ℰ}^{\gamma}_4
  +\mathcal{ℰ}^{\gamma\psi}_4
  +\mathcal{ℰ}^{\psi}_4.
\end{aligned}
```

The formulas below use $`B_3=n_2\cup_1n_2`$ on each input and on the output,
$`\Delta B_3=B_3[N_2]-B_3[n_2]-B_3[n'_2]`$,
$`B_3^+=[n_2+n'_2]_2\cup_1[n_2+n'_2]_2`$, $`\lambda_2^\gamma=n_2\cup_2n'_2`$,
and the finite pair reference of the P move,

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal B_2(012)={}&[n_1]_2(01)[\lfloor n'_1/2\rfloor]_2(12)
 +[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2(01)[n'_1]_2(12)
 +[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2(01)[\lfloor n'_1/2\rfloor]_2(12)\\
&+n_2(012)n'_2(012)
 +[n_1]_2(01)[n'_1]_2(12)[n_2(012)+n'_2(012)]\\
&+s_1(01)\{[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2(01)[n'_1]_2(12)
 +[n_1]_2(01)[n'_1]_2(01)[[n_1]_2(12)+[n'_1]_2(12)]\}.
\end{aligned}
```

The $`\Delta`$ below always uses the actual new output.
For two identical complete states with $`n_1=0`$, the entire correction
reduces to the [zero-p+ip self-stacking formula](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_MAJORANA_SELF_STACKING.md).

#### Complex fermions

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_4^c=\frac12\big[
 n_3\cup_2n'_3+(n_3+n'_3)\cup_2\mathcal{ℰ}_3\big].
```

#### Complex fermions and Majorana decoration

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_4^{c\gamma}
=\frac12\Big[
 \big[\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}\big]\cup_3n'_3
 +\Delta\Big(
 n_3\cup_3\big[\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}\big]\Big)\Big].
```

The $`\Delta`$ has its defined three terms: the value at $`(N_3,N_2)`$ minus the values at $`(n_3,n_2)`$ and $`(n'_3,n'_2)`$. It uses the actual stacked fields, including their p+ip carries. Both parity brackets retain the cochain differential terms.

#### Complex fermions and p+ip decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{ℰ}_4^{c\psi}(01234)
={}&\frac12\Big[
 \mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi[n_1]\cup_3n'_3
 +\Delta\big(n_3\cup_3\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\big)\\
&\qquad+(n_3+n'_3)\cup_2\Delta B_3+dB_3\cup_3n'_3+n_3\cup_2R'_3+B_3\cup_2n'_3\\
&\qquad+(B_3+R'_3)\cup_2(\mathcal{ℰ}_3+\Delta B_3)+(dn_3+dB_3)\cup_3R'_3\\
&\qquad+\Delta\big(B_3\cup_3(dn_3+dB_3)+n_3\cup_2B_3\big)\\
&\qquad+\omega_2\mathcal B_2+\mathcal B_2^2+d\mathcal B_2\cup_1\mathcal B_2
 +(\mathcal{ℰ}_3+\Delta B_3+d\mathcal B_2)\cup_2d\mathcal B_2\\
&\qquad+d\mathcal B_2\cup_3(dN_3+dB_3[N])\\
&\qquad+(B_3+R'_3)\cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1B_3^+
 +(\lambda_2^\gamma)^2+\omega_2\lambda_2^\gamma\\
&\qquad+d_{s_1}\big(\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_2d\lambda_2^\gamma
 +B_3\cup_3(\mathcal{ℰ}_3+n'_3)+R'_3\cup_3\mathcal{ℰ}_3+B_3[N]\cup_2\lambda_2^\gamma\big)\\
&\qquad+(dn_3+dn'_3+dB_3+dR'_3)\cup_4\big[
 \omega_2\mathcal{ℰ}_2+s_1(B_3[N]+B_3^+)\big]\Big](01234)\\
&+\frac12(dn_3+dB_3)(01234)\Big[
 n'_2(012)(dn_2)(0234)
 +n_2(034)(dn'_2)(0123)\\
&\qquad+n'_2(123)(dn_2)(0134)
 +n_2(014)(dn'_2)(1234)
 +n'_2(234)(dn_2)(0124)\\
&\qquad+s_1(01)\Big\{
 n'_2(124)(dn_2)(1234)
 +[n_2(123)+n'_2(123)](dn'_2)(1234)
 \Big\}\Big]\\
&+\frac12(dn'_3+dR'_3)(01234)\Big[
 n'_2(012)(dn_2)(0234)
 +n_2(034)(dn'_2)(0123)\\
&\qquad+s_1(01)\Big\{
 [n_2(123)+n'_2(124)](dn_2)(1234)
 +n_2(123)(dn'_2)(1234)
 \Big\}\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

The two face brackets contain **13 products** after distributing the
binary parentheses: eight multiply $`dn_3+dB_3`$ and five multiply $`dn'_3+dR'_3`$.
The [exchange reduction](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_CF_EXCHANGE_REDUCTION.md) proves
that this form is exact. The lower obstruction acts on its whole
binary argument; it must not be linearized.
The terms with $`B_3`$, $`\lambda_2^\gamma`$ and $`\mathcal B_2`$ come from the
pairing references of the complex fermions; together they vanish for
$`n_1=n'_1=0`$, so that the whole contribution vanishes there.

#### Majorana decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{ℰ}^{\gamma}_4={}&\frac12z_4^\gamma
 +\frac14\big[
 -\beta^-n_2\cup_2\beta^-n'_2\\
 &+(\beta^-n_2+\beta^-n'_2)
       \cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma
 -\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1
       \beta^-[n_2+n'_2]_2\\
 &+(\lambda_2^\gamma)^2-\omega_2\lambda_2^\gamma\big].
\end{aligned}
```

The binary completion is

```math
\begin{aligned}
z_4^\gamma={}&z^0_4(n_2,n'_2)
 +(\omega_2[n_2+n'_2]_2)\cup_3\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\gamma
 +d(n_2\cup_1n'_2)\cup_4
       (\omega_2[n_2+n'_2]_2)\\
&+(n'_2)^2\cup_4(\omega_2n_2)
 +[(n'_2)^2+\omega_2n'_2]\cup_4
                     (s_1[\beta^-n_2]_2)\\
&+(\omega_2\cup_1s_1)\lambda_2^\gamma
 +(n_2\cup_1n'_2)\cup_3
       [s_1([\beta^-n_2]_2
                       +[\beta^-n'_2]_2)]\\
&+[n_2+n'_2]_2^{\,2}\cup_3(s_1\lambda_2^\gamma)
 +(n_2\cup_1n'_2)\cup_2(s_1\lambda_2^\gamma)\\
&+s_1\Big[\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\gamma
 +[\beta^-n_2]_2\cup_3
                     [\beta^-n'_2]_2
 +\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma\\
&\qquad+([\beta^-n_2]_2
                      +[\beta^-n'_2]_2)
                    \cup_3(s_1\lambda_2^\gamma)
 +(s_1\lambda_2^\gamma)\cup_2\lambda_2^\gamma\\
&\qquad+[
 \beta^{-+}[n_2+n'_2]_2
 -\beta^{-+}n_2-\beta^{-+}n'_2]_2\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

Here $`\mathcal{ℰ}_3^\gamma=n_2\cup_1n'_2
+s_1(n_2\cup_2n'_2)`$ and
$`\beta^{-+}x=(\beta^- x+[\beta^- x]_2)/2=\lfloor(dx+2)/4\rfloor`$.
Its intrinsic binary polynomial is

```math
\begin{aligned}
z^0_4(x,y)={}&\sum_{\substack{v\in\{12123434,12134131,12314324,12314342,\\
                         13242412,13413142,13432412\}}}\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(x,x,y,y)\\
&+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{12123}(x+y,y,x\cup_2y)
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{123131}(y,x,x\cup_1y)\\
&+(x\cup_1y)\cup_1y
 +([\beta^- x]_2+[\beta^- y]_2)\cup_1(x\cup_2y)\\
&+(x\cup_2y)\cup_1
  ([\beta^- x]_2+[\beta^- y]_2+y\cup_1x)\\
&+(x\cup_1y)\cup_3(x^2+y^2)
 +y\cup_2[x\cup_1(x\cup_1y)]
 +[\beta^- y]_2\cup_2[\beta^- x]_2.
\end{aligned}
```

The finite word sum contains **seven specified MS terms**.
The other displayed terms of $`z_4^0`$ are outside this sum. The complete
$`z_4^0`$ has **20 distributed terms**; the complete $`z_4^\gamma`$ has
**37**, retaining the defined lower twister, integer carries, and whole
lift scopes.

#### Majorana and p+ip decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{ℰ}^{\gamma\psi}_4={}&
 \frac12\Big[z_4^\gamma+
   \sum_{(v;\boldsymbol x)\in\mathcal I_{4,\neg\psi}}
          \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\boldsymbol x)\\
&\qquad+\omega_2\lambda_2^\gamma
 +d_{s_1}(\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_2d\lambda_2^\gamma)\Big]\\
&-\frac14\Big[
 -\beta^-n_2\cup_2 \beta_3^{\psi\prime}
 -\beta_3^\psi\cup_2\beta^-n'_2
 +\beta^-n_2\cup_3
       [ (\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)n'_1]\\
&\quad+(\beta^-n_2+\beta^-n'_2)
       \cup_2d\lambda_2
 +(\beta_3^\psi+\beta_3^{\psi\prime})
       \cup_2d(\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^{\gamma\psi})\\
&\quad+\lambda_2\cup_1d\lambda_2-\lambda_2^2
 -\lambda_2^\psi\cup_1d\lambda_2^\psi+(\lambda_2^\psi)^2
 +\omega_2\lambda_2^{\gamma\psi}\\
&\quad-\big[N_2^2-n_2^2-(n'_2)^2
                      -([n_1]_2[n'_1]_2)^2\big]\\
&\quad+d_{s_1}\Big[
 (\beta^-n_2+\beta^-n'_2)
                     \cup_2\lambda_2^\gamma
 +(d\lambda_2^\gamma)\cup_3d\lambda_2^\gamma
 -[n_2\cup_1n'_2]_2\Big]\\
&\quad-(\beta^-n_2+\beta^-n'_2)
                  \cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma
 +\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1
        \beta^-[n_2+n'_2]_2
 -(\lambda_2^\gamma)^2
 \Big].
\end{aligned}
```

The MS sum over $`\mathcal I_{4,\neg\psi}`$ contains **15,994 terms**
after exact collection; $`z_4^\gamma`$ is outside that sum. The quarter-valued
quadratic expression uses the total integer carry $`\lambda_2`$ and
subtracts the same expression in $`\lambda_2^\psi`$. These **four terms**
are exact because
$`\lambda_2=\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^{\gamma\psi}+\lambda_2^\psi`$
is an equality of integer cochains. Expanding this split recovers the
eight ordered pairs other than $`(\psi,\psi)`$, or **16 cup terms**.
Further inserting the three carry definitions gives **24 distributed
integer-cup terms**. These are supplementary expansions; the whole
binary lift in the mixed carry retains its two-term interior and is not
distributed as an integer sum.

The two repeated quarter-valued copies of $`\omega_2\lambda_2^\gamma`$
have been combined in the half-valued bracket. The integer differential of

These are exact coefficient combinations, with no change of phase
coordinate or reassignment of physical contributions.

On the closed-Majorana tower, $`n_1=n'_1=0`$, this mixed Majorana–p+ip
contribution vanishes. Its half and quarter brackets need not separately
vanish; canceling the binary parity of a quarter term is not sufficient.

#### p+ip decoration

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{ℰ}^{\psi}_4={}&
 \frac12\left[
 \sum_{(v;\boldsymbol x)\in\mathcal I_{4,\psi}}
         \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\boldsymbol x)+\sum_{(f,g)\in\mathcal I_4^{\psi,\mathrm{face}}}f\,g\right]\\
&-\frac14\Big[
 -\beta_3^\psi\cup_2\beta_3^{\psi\prime}
 +\beta_3^\psi\cup_3[(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)n'_1]
 +(\beta_3^\psi+\beta_3^{\psi\prime})\cup_2d\lambda_2^\psi\\
&\quad+\lambda_2^\psi\cup_1d\lambda_2^\psi
       -(\lambda_2^\psi)^2+\omega_2\lambda_2^\psi
       -([n_1]_2[n'_1]_2)^2
 -[[\lfloor \beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2/2\rfloor]_2
                   ([n_1]_2\cup_1[n'_1]_2)]_2\Big]\\
&+\frac18\widetilde{\omega}_2 n_1n'_1.
\end{aligned}
```

The sums contain **6,479 ordinary MS terms** and **4,094 physical-face
monomials**, respectively. These are the expanded sums themselves; the
following quarter- and eighth-valued terms are additional.

##### Physical-face coefficients

On an ordered four-simplex the remaining half-valued term is the following
finite polynomial in the physical integer digits and background faces:

```math
\frac12\sum_{(f,g)\in\mathcal I_4^{\psi,\mathrm{face}}}f\,g.
```

This sum contains **4,094 physical-face monomials** after every background
coefficient is multiplied out and identical monomials are collected.
Every pair $`(f,g)`$ is printed in the
[physical-face coefficient table](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_INTEGER_PRODUCT_FACES.md).
Its 173 factored rows group 306 integer-digit monomials by common
background coefficients; neither of those two row counts is the expanded
term count. Each table entry contains
only $`[n_1]_2`$, $`[\lfloor n_1/2\rfloor]_2`$, their primed counterparts, the
explicit third digit $`[\lfloor n_1/4\rfloor]_2`$, and the
physical faces of $`s_1`$, $`\omega_2`$, and $`\widetilde{\omega}_2`$.

#### Physical fields, carries, and arithmetic

The lower product and source in these displays are the already fixed laws

```math
\begin{aligned}
N_1&=n_1+n'_1,\qquad
N_2=n_2+n'_2+[n_1]_2[n'_1]_2,\\
N_3&=n_3+n'_3+\mathcal{ℰ}_3,\qquad
 dn_3=(\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi})[n_2]+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi[n_1],\\
\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma[x]&=x^2+s_1(x\cup_1x)+\omega_2x,\\
\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}[x]&=x\cup_1dx+s_1(x\cup_2dx).
\end{aligned}
```

All cochain Steenrod squares include their differential terms. The integer carries appearing in the formulas are:

```math
\begin{aligned}
\beta^- x&=(dx-[dx]_2)/2=\lfloor dx/2\rfloor,\\
\beta_3&=\beta^-n_2+\beta_3^\psi
 =\frac{dn_2+\widetilde{\omega}_2n_1}{2},\\
\beta_3^\psi&=([\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2]_2
                         +\widetilde{\omega}_2n_1)/2,\\
\lambda_2^\gamma&=n_2\cup_2n'_2,\\
\lambda_2^{\gamma\psi}
 &=[n_2+n'_2]_2
                  \cup_2([n_1]_2[n'_1]_2),\\
\lambda_2^\psi&=(n_1n'_1-[[n_1]_2[n'_1]_2]_2)/2,\\
\lambda_2&=\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^{\gamma\psi}
            +\lambda_2^\psi
 =\frac{n_2+n'_2+n_1n'_1-N_2}{2}.
\end{aligned}
```

Every binary field in an integer expression means its canonical zero-or-one
lift. Bars on full sums retain their complete reduction boundary. The
integer products in $`\widetilde{\omega}_2n_1`$ and $`n_1n'_1`$ use the inherited
local systems; the latter is closed and untwisted. In particular the full
residual satisfies $`d\beta_3=(\beta_{s_1}\widetilde{\omega}_2)n_1`$, whereas differentiating
$`\beta_3^\psi`$ alone need not give that expression. The origin selection uses the
full legal derivative before selecting its p+ip descendant.

#### The finite phase polynomials

The [lower word indices](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_PRODUCT_WORD_INDICES.md) also use the nine-term phase numerator

```math
\begin{aligned}
H_4[x]={}&x\cup_1\mathrm{Sq}^1\omega_2
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{1321}(x,\omega_2,s_1)
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{12131}(x,x,x)\\
&+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{132123}(x,x,\mathrm{Sq}^1x)
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{2321232}(x,\mathrm{Sq}^1x,\mathrm{Sq}^1x)\\
&+(\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{34123121}+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{34123212})
      (x,\mathrm{Sq}^1x,\omega_2,s_1)\\
&+\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{41231231}(x,x,\mathrm{Sq}^1x,s_1)
 +\mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_{12131243}(x,x,x,x).
\end{aligned}
```

The derivative of its integer quarter partner, the literal square of $`x`$,
is already displayed in the mixed and pure quarter formulas. It has not
been absorbed into a binary word table.


<a id="closed-sector"></a>

## Closed sector

For $`n_1=n'_1=0`$ one has $`\beta^-=\beta`$, $`B_3`$ is closed, and every
contribution on this page reduces to the
[closed-sector formulas](MAJORANA_AND_ENDPOINTS.md#majorana-3d); the
contributions $`\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{c\psi},\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{\gamma\psi},\mathcal{𝒪}_5^\psi,
\mathcal{ℰ}_4^{c\psi},\mathcal{ℰ}_4^{\gamma\psi},\mathcal{ℰ}_4^\psi`$ vanish.
